summary: Read two binary trees that are both non-empty, named s and t. Decide whether t lines up with some subtree of s: the shape is the same, and the number stored at every matching node is the same. A subtree of s is one node of s together with every descendant under that node. The entire tree s also counts as a subtree of itself. Write true when a lineup exists, and write false when it does not.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
